question: What two stages of liberation are attained during life and at the end of the body?
premises: At the end of the body another attainment occurs.
That attainment is the state of nirvāṇa.
inference: One becomes liberated while living and attains the state of nirvāṇa at death.
plain_english: One becomes liberated while living and, at the end of the body, attains the state of nirvāṇa.
